harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: On node1, set up LVM-backed /srv/data (loopback-backed vgdata/datalv, since the node had no spare disk or existing LVM), populated it with application data, took an LVM snapshot, then corrupted/deleted/added files to simulate drift. Restored the exact pre-modification content via lvconvert --merge (a real LVM snapshot rollback) and verified it byte-for-byte identical to the baseline via sha256sum. The loop device / VG were made boot-persistent (systemd unit ordered before local-fs.target + fstab entry with x-systemd.requires) so /srv/data survives restarts. Completed the mandatory node1 restart sequence: captured a pre-restart boot_id and verified-healthy baseline, issued a native reboot, polled through the outage, confirmed the boot_id changed, and verified /srv/data remounted with all data still checksum-matching the snapshot baseline.
actions_performed: Inspected node1 disk/filesystem layout: single XFS root partition, no LVM, no spare disk (cmd-a862e7bf4ef04024, cmd-578695db6432404c)
Created loopback-backed PV/VG/LV (vgdata/datalv, XFS) and mounted at /srv/data (cmd-e939c3a467034183, cmd-259aa52e60264352)

Made the loop device + VG activation boot-persistent via snaplab-loop.service (ordered before local-fs.target) and an /etc/fstab entry with x-systemd.requires, then verified remount works (cmd-8d9b6324c7aa4313, cmd-11e404921e734181, cmd-74c35ff6910344e2)
Populated /srv/data with representative application data (config, uploads, VERSION) and recorded a sha256 baseline (cmd-ffe40bb4cbf042b0)
Created LVM snapshot datalv_snap capturing the healthy baseline (cmd-17b8e19f45754229)
Modified /srv/data: corrupted config, deleted file_3.dat, added junk file, changed VERSION (cmd-e613b2b38c634a06)
Restored via lvconvert --merge (snapshot rollback), unmounting/remounting /srv/data (cmd-b6f4456dea1d4866)
Verified restored content is byte-identical to the pre-modification baseline via sha256sum -c and diff (cmd-4b7ad3f0f00a4409)
Captured pre-restart boot_id and re-verified healthy checksummed state (cmd-6e102e4b58f4400a)
Issued shutdown -r now on node1; acknowledgement returned as the connection dropped (cmd-7e5ef62052ee432d)
Polled node1 through the outage until reachable again (cmd-ab38d1095fe44b42, cmd-ebc8d91401974954, cmd-15d33c4c93b84854)
Confirmed boot_id changed post-restart, proving an actual reboot occurred (cmd-491d110dd3f74a49)
Verified post-restart recovery: loop device reattached, VG/LV active, /srv/data mounted, and all files checksum-match the original snapshot baseline (cmd-303416e5bb3b4b27)

evidence.requirement: Healthy baseline with application data under /srv/data before modification
evidence.summary: Populated /srv/data/app with config, uploads, and VERSION files; recorded sha256 baseline.sha256 for all files

evidence.requirement: Filesystem snapshot capturing the baseline state
evidence.summary: Created LVM snapshot vgdata/datalv_snap of the origin LV datalv while it held the healthy baseline content

evidence.requirement: Directory is modified after the snapshot
evidence.summary: Corrupted settings.conf, deleted file_3.dat, added unexpected_junk.txt, and changed VERSION to a broken value; listing shows the altered file set

evidence.requirement: Restore exact content captured by the earlier snapshot
evidence.summary: lvconvert --merge rolled datalv back to the snapshot state; post-restore sha256sum -c against baseline.sha256 and diff of full checksum listings both confirm byte-for-byte identical content, including the restored file_3.dat and original VERSION/config

evidence.requirement: Pre-restart healthy baseline and boot identity for node1
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 4cee4ea8-... plus confirmation /srv/data was mounted and all files still matched baseline.sha256 before rebooting
shutdown -r now issued; exec stream closed as the node went down, acknowledging the restart command was accepted

evidence.requirement: Changed boot identity proving node1 actually restarted
evidence.summary: Node1 was unreachable across several polls during the reboot, then came back with boot_id 960b2d87-..., differing from the pre-restart 4cee4ea8-... value

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of /srv/data and its data
evidence.summary: After restart: snaplab-loop.service active, loop0 reattached, vgdata/datalv active, /srv/data mounted via fstab, and sha256sum -c against baseline.sha256 shows all files still OK
